Hong Kong & China: mainland gold jewellery demand fell a third year on year, while bar and coin buying surged — and the two nearly cancelled out, the China Gold Association said Wednesday.

中國黃金協會週三公佈，今年首三季內地黃金首飾消費量按年下跌33.86%，至178.612噸；金條及金幣消費則逆市增長26.26%，至444.576噸；兩者相抵，黃金消費總量僅微升0.28%，至684.623噸。
